registered_before: engine/01_forecast.py and engine/02_analyze.py were executed for the first time
note: This file was committed to git BEFORE the forecast engine or the backtest was run. Thresholds are project-defined design choices, not official NFL or sportsbook policy, and are flagged as such on the Flagged for Review page. A gate that cannot be evaluated is Blocked, not Passed.

splits.development: 1999-2022 (model may be inspected; no threshold is tuned on the holdout)
splits.holdout: 2025-2026 (scored once; no parameter is changed after the holdout is read)
splits.note: The holdout is defined by calendar season, so every holdout game is strictly later than every validation game. The engine processes games in chronological order and never uses a later result to set an earlier forecast.

gates.name: Minimum graded sample
gates.threshold: at least 300 graded bets in the holdout for the strategy under evaluation
gates.rationale: Below 300 graded bets no NFL strategy can be separated from luck at conventional confidence; this floor is a project-defined design choice.

gates.name: Positive point estimate
gates.threshold: holdout ROI > 0% and holdout ROI > 0% for the price-independent forecast-skill metric
gates.rationale: A strategy that does not make money on the holdout cannot be rewarded, regardless of significance.

gates.name: Permutation significance
gates.threshold: one-sided permutation p-value < 0.05, labels shuffled within the strategy 10,000 times
gates.rationale: Removes any assumption that bets are independent.

gates.name: Interval excludes break-even
gates.threshold: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap confidence interval for ROI > 0%
gates.rationale: A point estimate above zero whose interval includes zero is not evidence of skill.

gates.name: Multiple-comparison control
gates.threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q < 0.05 across the whole strategy family tested
gates.rationale: Twelve strategies are tested; without family-wise control the chance of a false positive is far above 5%.

gates.name: Look-ahead integrity
gates.threshold: perturbing the outcome of any holdout game must not change any forecast made before that game (exact equality of the earlier forecast array)
gates.rationale: A forecast contaminated by a later result cannot be validated on the same data.

gates.name: Price provenance
gates.threshold: every price used must come from a recorded source with a retrievable URL, commit SHA and checksum, and every row must be labelled with that source's official/third-party status
gates.rationale: An unpriced result cannot be audited. The NFL publishes no betting lines, so every price in this project is third-party and must be labelled as such.

gates.name: Luck / placebo calibration
gates.threshold: the strategy's one-sided p-value must beat the 95th percentile of a 1,000-strategy placebo null on the same holdout, and the placebo false-positive rate must not exceed 10%
gates.rationale: If random strategies routinely beat the null at the stated threshold, the threshold itself is not evidence of skill.

gates.name: Skill stability
gates.threshold: the strategy's price-independent forecast skill must beat the naive baseline on the holdout, and the strategy must be non-negative in at least 2 of the 3 seasons in the validation+holdout window
gates.rationale: Skill that appears in one season and disappears in the next is luck with a time stamp.

gates.name: Reward eligibility
gates.threshold: a strategy earns reward points only if G1-G9 all pass; points are non-monetary until the owner funds a pool
gates.rationale: Separates the forecast board (which can be paid because it needs no prices) from the betting board (which needs prices that the NFL does not publish).

model_parameters.rating_alpha_note: Share of the residual applied to the team's offensive and defensive rating after each game.
model_parameters.mean_reversion_note: Share of a team's rating reverted toward the league mean after each game.
model_parameters.home_field_advantage_note: Fixed project assumption, applied only when the designated home team hosted the game. Neutral-site games (recorded in the location field) get no home-field advantage.
model_parameters.league_mean_note: Prior for the league mean points per team per game, used with an expanding window of prior results.
model_parameters.sigma_note: Prior for the residual standard deviation used to convert a point differential into a win probability.
model_parameters.min_games_note: No minimum; the model may forecast from the first game of the archive, but such forecasts are flagged as cold-start.
